_comment: Multi-step registration flows. Edited via /admin/registration/flows; rendered on landing pages by the 'registration-flow' section (pick a flow in the Page Builder). Field types: text, email, phone, number, textarea, select, choice (button group), yesno, file, computed (a live display-only price. When 'priced': true it is calculated SERVER-SIDE from the private pricing config (functions/api/_pricing-config.json, edited in the admin Pricing tab): names a 'selfField' and 'publisherField' number field, and offer = (payoutRatePct/100) × (selfRecovery × self + publisherRecovery × publisher). Supports prefix/suffix and gateOn to hide until a field is filled), works-summary (display-only list of works read from an uploaded claim form). A file field may carry 'extract' (a server extractor name, e.g. 'bartz-claim') plus 'extractMap' ({ flowFieldId: 'path.into.result' }) — on upload the file is POSTed to /api/extract-claim and the named fields auto-fill. A step with showIf only appears when the named earlier field equals the given value; a FIELD may also carry showIf (same {fieldId, equals} shape) to conditionally show/hide within the same step — used to keep a branch driver (like Authored/Published) and its branch-specific fields together on one page. A required 'choice' field with no answer yet auto-defaults to its first option. Submissions POST to /api/register → notification email (+ Google Sheet, + Attio when ATTIO_API_KEY is configured, labeled with attioLabel).

flows.intro:
Submit your claim details to see what your claim is worth.
No obligation and 100% confidential.

To sell, you will need a valid form of ID (driver's license, passport or permanent residency card), proof of address and the unique identification number assigned to you by the Settlement Administrator (JND). Have your claim form ready to speed up your offer and payment.
